title: AI Shopping Answer Sources: Hand Massagers
subtitle: Web sources ChatGPT and Perplexity cited for 39 hand massager questions
description: Which web sources two AI assistants (ChatGPT and Perplexity) cited or inspected when answering 39 shopping questions about hand massagers, recorded over 137 runs on 2026-10-16 and 2026-10-19: 2900 source rows (472 cited, 2428 inspected) across 456 domains, plus 296 search sub-queries the assistants issued. Descriptive counts only: AI answers vary run to run. The answers themselves are not included. This dataset makes no medical claims. Compiled by Wearmelly (wearmelly.com), which sells Melly, a heated hand massager not included in this dataset.
